summary.text: Dave Vieira is a Republican state representative from Falmouth who has represented the 3rd Barnstable District since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has served as Falmouth town moderator since 1998 and lists his profession as public safety and legislator.

paragraphs.text: Vieira, listed in legislative records as David Vieira, was a Falmouth Town Meeting member in 1997 and 1998 and has been Falmouth's town moderator since 1998.
He lists his profession as public safety and legislator.
Vieira has served in the Massachusetts House since 2011 and advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

He is ranking minority member of the Special Joint Committee on Initiative Petitions and serves on the House Committee on Ethics and the Joint Committees on Emergency Preparedness and Management and on Tourism, Arts and Cultural Development.
